verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since sustained performance and power envelopes are a fair question for a laptop SoC, but the pack does not deliver either part of the story. Qualcomm explicitly publishes no TDP or power figure on the X2 Elite spec page and leaves power envelopes to OEMs. The only efficiency support is a press-release headline claiming 'most efficient'. No independent sustained-load or performance-per-watt testing appears, and community comments note the missing TDP data and are still waiting for independent reviews.
